name: Yeh'kinya
summary: Yeh'kinya is a jungle troll scholar residing at Steamwheedle Port on the desert coast of Tanaris. Claiming to seek ancient lore and artifacts to understand dark powers, he dispatches willing adventurers across Azeroth on missions to gather lost troll relics.

sections.title: The Scholar at Steamwheedle Port
sections.body: Lounging among the goblins and dockworkers of Steamwheedle Port, Yeh'kinya presents himself as a quiet student of history and spirits. He recruits travelers to track down obscure magical items across Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms, from ancient eggs in the Hinterlands to stone prophecy tablets buried in the ruins of Zul'Farrak. While he claims these errands serve peaceful academic inquiry into ancient troll history, his specific focus on the blood god Hakkar draws suspicion from watchful onlookers.

sections.title: The Serpent's Deceit
sections.body: Beneath his scholarly guise, Yeh'kinya is a fanatical worshipper of Hakkar the Soulflayer. Every artifact and soul essence he gathers is carefully manipulated to prepare for the dread Blood God's physical rebirth into Azeroth. Once his plot is pieced together and exposed by Prospector Ironboot, Yeh'kinya sheds all pretense of friendship. Rather than answering for his treason, he transforms into a green wind serpent and flees across the open sea toward the south seas, leaving duped heroes to seek aid from the Zandalari on Yojamba Isle.

faq.answer: Yeh'kinya is a jungle troll found standing near the water at Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris. Outwardly, he acts as a scholar seeking historical relics and spirits, but he is secretly a covert agent working to orchestrate the return of Hakkar the Soulflayer.

faq.q: Why does Yeh'kinya want the Prophecy of Mosh'aru and the Ancient Egg?
faq.answer: Yeh'kinya tricks adventurers into recovering these powerful artifacts under the guise of safe research. In truth, the Mosh'aru tablets contain rituals and lore concerning the binding and summoning of Hakkar, and the items provided help pave the way for the Soulflayer's physical manifestation in Zul'Gurub.

Prospector Ironboot uncovers the truth behind the scholar's requests and alerts the adventurer. When confronted with evidence of his deception, Yeh'kinya abandons his guise, transforms into a flying green wind serpent, and escapes over the ocean to join his cultist allies.

faq.q: What should adventurers do after Yeh'kinya escapes?
faq.answer: Following Yeh'kinya's flight, Prospector Ironboot directs duped heroes to Yojamba Isle off the coast of Stranglethorn Vale. There, the Zandalari tribe has gathered to rally champions and find a way to halt Hakkar's return.

angles.text: Darkspear trolls recognize the mortal peril of Hakkar's resurgence; being tricked into aiding a Hakkari cultist is a bitter sting against the tribe's defiance of the Blood God.
Priests sensitive to spiritual essence may find Yeh'kinya's casual collection of trapped screecher spirits deeply troubling long before his true loyalty to Hakkar is unmasked.
